inductiveReasoning.description: Codebook evolution / inductive revision of codes

codeStability.description: Stability of codes once introduced (inverse of churn)

contextSensitivity.description: Variable coding units / span diversity and disagreement engagement

reflexiveAwareness.description: Documented reasons, memos, and reflection responses

evidence_templates.high_rename: Codes were renamed multiple times during analysis
evidence_templates.rename_without_reason: Several code renames lack a documented change note
evidence_templates.rename_with_reason: Codebook changes often include a written rationale
evidence_templates.high_codebook_churn: The codebook continued to evolve across the coding period
evidence_templates.stable_codebook: Codebook structure remained relatively stable after early coding
evidence_templates.span_variable: Coding span / selection length varies substantially
evidence_templates.span_uniform: Coding units tend toward similar selection lengths
evidence_templates.resolved_disagreements: Disagreements were discussed and resolved through consensus
evidence_templates.memo_active: Reflexive memos / task notes were written during coding
evidence_templates.memo_sparse: Few reflexive memos accompany coding decisions
evidence_templates.emerging: Behavioral signals are still forming; stance remains emerging
